Team,

Quick draft: attached is a compact succession matrix and an initial OKR alignment doc for the Q4 QBR. Goal is to:

- Fold planned role coverage into the QBR talking points so stakeholders see headcount and risk tradeoffs
- Surface backfill timing and interim owners for any director-level moves
- Confirm measurable OKR shifts tied to the reassignments (no surprises in SLT review)

Please review the two attachments (succession_matrix_v2.xlsx, qbr_okr_alignment_v1.pdf) and comment inline by EOD monday (2026-10-05). Specific asks:

1) Marcus — confirm timing for product leadership handoffs and the proposed interim owner for Data Platform
2) Grace — note any customer-facing risks we should include in the comms
3) Karthik — advise on canary comm windows for managers + HR approval steps

I've started a one-pager for the QBR talking points (qbr_talking_points_draft.md) — that will be the single slide we share with execs.

Thanks — want to get a final comm plan Friday so we can bake it into the QBR deck.

—Stephanie

- Canary audience: run the talking points by two frontline managers and a customer reference (Grace, please suggest one contact).
- HR approvals: People Ops should confirm final offer/market adjustments before any public-facing announcement. I'll add a checklist in PEOPLE-482.

2) For critical pilots, name an escalation path (primary/backup) directly in the slide so the QBR audience can see continuity planning.

I've attached a one-page rollout timeline (stub: people_rollout_timeline_v1.pdf) and a sample comms manager email. If you want, I can run a quick manager training session (15 min) the week of Oct 19.
